artifacts.summary: Implementation summary for pr-review-research skill and agent creation

completion_data.completion_summary: Created skill-pr-review-research and pr-review-research-agent in the CSLib extension. The agent fetches GitHub PR data via gh api (4 endpoints: metadata, reviews, conversation comments, inline comments), optionally fetches Zulip thread content with graceful degradation when unconfigured, and synthesizes findings into a structured research report. Manifest routing updated so pr research tasks route to skill-pr-review-research instead of skill-researcher.

memory_candidates.content: PR review research agent pattern: use gh api for 4 GitHub endpoints (pulls/{num} metadata, pulls/{num}/reviews, issues/{num}/comments for conversation, pulls/{num}/comments for inline). Use --paginate for endpoints with many results. Truncate diff_hunk to first 5 lines. Check ~/.zuliprc for placeholder URLs before Zulip fetch using configparser pattern.

memory_candidates_harvested.disposition: reviewed; folded into consolidated cross-task memories
